jobs.title: Mechanical/Electrical Engineer
jobs.excerpt: When answers matter most, Keystone Experts & Engineers deliver.
jobs.description:
When answers matter most, Keystone Experts & Engineers deliver. Keystone specializes in forensic engineering and investigative services for commercial and residential structures, vehicles, and products. Our multi-disciplinary team includes highly experienced engineers, architects, fire investigators, contractors, and industry experts strategically located across the country to serve a national client base.

Keystone provides streamlined, fact-based forensic consulting services designed to meet our clients’ needs with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness. Our reports are tailored to client specifications and backed by expert analysis, ensuring clear, defensible conclusions and industry-leading turnaround times.

The Keystone Way is more than a process: it’s our commitment to excellence, innovation, integrity, honesty, accuracy, timeliness, and accountability. These values guide every project we undertake. By combining top-tier expertise, open communication, and dependable service, we go beyond industry standards to deliver results our clients can trust.

About the role

We are seeking licensed (PE) Mechanical/Electrical Engineers with experience completing forensic investigations to determine the cause and origin of various site issues; electrical/mechanical fire support, root cause analysis, commissioning and condition assessments correlate and weather-related damage to residential, commercial and industrial properties.

This is a fully remote, part-time, 1099 contracted position.

The ideal candidate will have experience...

  • With power surges, lightning strikes, and evaluating of electrical components after a fire or water intrusion event (wiring, control systems, panels, outlets, and appliances/equipment)
  • HVAC units – repair vs. replace after storm/hail damage, cause of damage – wind/hail, improper maintenance, improper installation or product defect of boilers, chillers, pumps, plumbing and heating systems.

What you will do:

  • Performs engineering failure analysis; specifically, determining cause and of damage, causes and origin of fire, electrocutions and equipment failures.
  • Capable of performing site evaluations, field analysis, and assessments that include mechanical, electrical and/or plumbing systems.
  • Provide evaluations for failures as a result of hail/wind damage, lightning strike damage, cause of damage – wind/hail, improper maintenance, improper installation or product defect of boilers, chillers, pumps, plumbing and heating systems., freeze events, machinery breakdown, wear and tear, general construction failures, and/or providing general recommendations for remediation and repair.
  • Safely access roofs, attics & crawl spaces to photo document areas of interest.
  • Identify and interview witnesses and/or other key parties involved.
  • Prepare & submit findings and recommendations that can be used to resolve insurance claims or litigation matters.

.What you will bring:

  • Active Professional Engineering license(s) required
  • Degree in Mechanical/Electrical engineering or similar field
  • Well-versed in building materials, codes, construction methods & common modes of failure
  • Ability to adhere to tight deadlines
  • Availability to readily accept assignments and perform site inspection within 5-7 days
  • Tech-savvy across multiple software platforms, tools / equipment & investigative techniques
  • Outstanding written & verbal communications skills
  • An analytical mind and strong problem-solving ability

Qualifications

jobs.title: Engineer Manager, Returns
jobs.excerpt: The Role & The ProductAt parcelLab, we help brands improve what happens after checkout: delivery updates, tracking, returns, customer communication, and the operational work behind all of it.
jobs.description:
The Role & The Product

At parcelLab, we help brands improve what happens after checkout: delivery updates, tracking, returns, customer communication, and the operational work behind all of it. We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Returns (v2) Platform team.

This is not a legacy maintenance role. Our Returns Portal is a recently rebuilt product area with deep Shopify integration, a native Shopify app, advanced exchange logic, customer profiles, fraud-prevention capabilities, and highly configurable workflows for enterprise customers. It is an AI-native product with AI embedded directly into the returns and back-office experience, including agent-driven customisation and automation logic.

Returns sound simple from the outside, but the technical reality is highly complex. The platform must handle intricate eligibility rules, routing logic, carrier integrations, and endless edge cases while remaining incredibly reliable in production.

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead the engineering team responsible for this platform, working across backend services, APIs, workflows, and AI-assisted capabilities. You do not need to be on the critical path for daily implementation, but you must stay close enough to the system to review designs, spot risks early, and maintain technical credibility with a team of experienced engineers. You’ll bring clarity to complex architectural decisions, collaborate closely with cross-functional peers (Product, Design, Infrastructure, and Commercial teams), and create the space for senior engineers to do their best work.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of experienced engineers, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with Product and Go-To-Market teams to shape the Returns Platform roadmap and turn ambiguity into clear execution plans.

  • Guide technical decisions across backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and complex product capabilities like rules engines and Shopify integrations.

  • Help the team make practical trade-offs around delivery speed, reliability, technical debt, extensibility, and long-term platform health.

  • Own the talent lifecycle for your team, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career growth paths.

  • Champion modern engineering tools, helping the team integrate AI into their development workflows thoughtfully without lowering the bar for quality.

What we’re looking for (Non-Negotiables)

  • Proven leadership track record: Experience leading and coaching senior engineers through complex product and architecture decisions in a SaaS, platform, or B2B environment.

  • Core Technical Credibility (Python): A strong technical background in backend engineering, distributed systems, and scalable APIs. Because our V2 platform relies heavily on Python, you must have hands-on experience with Python and its ecosystem (e.g., Django) to effectively review designs, challenge technical assumptions, and guide the team.

  • Enterprise Product Judgment: Comfort building highly configurable enterprise products without turning the platform into bespoke, customer-by-customer software.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to build strong relationships and communicate clearly with both deeply technical engineers and non-technical commercial stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic Delivery Focus: Strong judgment around sequencing, technical debt, and maintainability—you aren't satisfied just because "the tickets are done."

Bonus points (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Domain Expertise: Experience in e-commerce, logistics, returns, fulfilment, post-purchase, or supply chain platforms.

  • Ecosystem Experience: Deep familiarity with Shopify, commerce platforms, carrier integrations, or merchant tooling.

  • Advanced Workflows: Experience with complex exchange flows, customer profiles, fraud prevention, rules engines, or event-driven architecture.

  • Tech Stack Extras: Experience with PostgreSQL, AWS, Terraform, or modern observability tooling.

  • AI & Automation: Experience building AI-assisted product capabilities, internal tools, or agent-driven workflows.

  • Distributed Teams: Experience leading remote or internationally distributed teams.

This role is a good fit if

  • You enjoy leading strong engineers without needing to micro-manage or control every detail.

  • You thrive in product areas where the complexity is real: edge cases, heavy integrations, and tight operational constraints.

  • You are genuinely interested in how AI can become part of the core product architecture and daily engineering workflow.

  • You can challenge a roadmap constructively, asking the sharp questions that help a team navigate trade-offs between speed and quality.

Why join parcelLab

parcelLab connects tracking, delivery, returns, and customer engagement in one post-purchase platform. We help brands reduce friction for their customers and build stronger relationships after checkout.

Our Returns Platform is one of the product areas where a lot is being rebuilt, expanded, and pushed forward. You’ll join at a point where the foundation is new, the product ambition is high, and the technical decisions still matter.

Every day, we:

  • Monitor over six million shipments.

  • Support customers across 175+ countries.

  • Power post-purchase experiences for 1,000+ brands.

  • Integrate with 350+ carriers worldwide.

  • Work as a global team of 150+ people.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

  • Flexible remote-first working.

  • Career development and mentorship opportunities.

  • Mental wellbeing support and coaching.

  • Regular company retreats, meet-ups, and off-sites.

  • A collaborative international team representing 25+ nationalities.

  • A culture that values creativity, experimentation, ownership, and practical execution.

At parcelLab, people bring their own perspectives. We judge qualifications and performance, not age, sex, religion, skin colour, gender identity, family status, or disability.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.excerpt: AECOM is seeking a skilled Mechanical Engineer to join our Water business line, specializing in large scale mechanical engineering projects to be based anywhere in the United States.
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a skilled Mechanical Engineer to join our Water business line, specializing in large scale mechanical engineering projects to be based anywhere in the United States. In this role, you will design, develop, and oversee the design of large-scale mechanical systems that are critical to water infrastructure.

You will work on a variety of complex projects involving water control structures such as vertical lift gates, radial gates, sluice gates, Tainter gates, sector gates, bulkheads, and stoplogs. Additionally, you will be involved with sizing and specifying winches, wire rope and chain hoisting systems, hydraulic, pneumatic and electric actuators, gear systems, and other precision mechanisms associated with these gates, delivering solutions that meet the highest standards of performance and reliability. Familiarity with various types of cranes, including Overhead Gantry Cranes and Rail Mounted Gantry Cranes that are associated with these structures is a plus. The ideal candidate will also have experience with large pumps and pumping stations and be experienced with Autodesk CAD software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop large-scale mechanical systems for water infrastructure projects.
  • Create 3D models using Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Revit or other mechanical design software for use in design drawings.
  • Size and select hoists, actuators and associated waterworks mechanical systems.
  • Conduct engineering calculations and analysis to ensure structural integrity and mechanical performance according to industry standards and specifications.
  • Review and approve engineering drawings and vendor submittals.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including Civil, Structural, and Electrical Engineers.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements.
  • Prepare technical reports, specifications, and documentation.
  • Support proposal development by providing technical input.
  • The ability to travel a few times a year for site visits and meetings with clients.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an ABET accredited Mechanical Engineering university program and 6+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • Professional Engineering licensure in the United States or abilty to obtain licensure within two years

Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years of mechanical engineering design related to water, infrastructure, or similar industrial mechanical equipment.
  • Experience with locks, dams and other large water works structures.
  • Ability to work independently with guidance.
  • The ability to travel a few times a year for site visits and meetings with clients.
  • Mechanical design experience of gates, hoisting mechanisms, actuators or large-scale mechanical systems.
  • Experience with cranes or other lifting devices.
  • Experience with hydraulic systems and hydraulic schematics.
  • Experience with large pumps, pump stations or pumping systems.
  • Experience with heavy steel fabrication, welding, construction and/or large-scale mechanical engineering projects.
  • Proficiency in Autodesk Inventor, Autodesk Revit or other 3D design tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Proficiency with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software and analysis methods.
  • Experience working in hybrid environments with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Relocation is not available for this role
  • Sponsorship is not available for ths role.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
